rules.dungeon_and_raid: excluded from outdoor route but retained as excluded task cards
rules.repeatable_daily_weekly_monthly: first run may be eligible; no second-run generation by default
rules.task_selection_policy: no level-based all-clear or speed-only deletion; compare do-now / do-later / never-do by impact on this quest-cycle total gold, total wall-clock, and gold-per-hour; do not import raid/daily opportunity cost

route_mechanism_notes.11591: 《钢腭的车队》是可选面包屑；11592/11593/11594可直接接做，之后11591会失去可接资格。当前基线路线不做11591。
route_mechanism_notes.12177: 《休尼克的掩饰》需要1份煤块和5份面粉；两者都可在征服堡内向商人购买。Questie物品来源展开会把煤块的全世界掉落源带入route_zones，不能因此误判为副本任务。

rules.max_level_gold: Quest::XPValue(80) * 6 copper; base WotLK XP, no 2x leveling multiplier

tasks.objective_text_en: Etaruk, on the outskirts of the Coldrock Quarry, wants you to kill Curator Insivius.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_en: Chieftain Wintergale at Taunka'le Village wants you to bring him 5 Scourged Mammoth Pelts.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 返回灵语者身边

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的复仇者伊芬要你进入瓦基里安，杀死风暴语者伊尔达。
tasks.objective_text_en: Iva the Vengeful at Brunnhildar Village wants you to slay Yulda the Stormspeaker in Valkyrion.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 这是你的地精吗？
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向安格妮塔·泰斯多达尔发起挑战，救出西弗·菲兹巴克。成功之后，向布伦希尔达村的女巫洛莉拉复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Challenge Agnetta Tyrsdottar in order to save Zeev Fizzlespark. Return to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village after you've succeeded.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 海德比武会
tasks.objective_text_zh: 听取女巫洛莉拉的提议。
tasks.objective_text_en: Listen to Lok'lira the Crone's proposal.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 迎接挑战者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的女巫洛莉拉要你去打败6名获胜的挑战者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 你需要一头熊
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与布伦希尔达村外的布莉亚娜谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Brijana outside Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 铜须兄弟
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与布莱恩·铜须及其飞行器一起返回冰霜堡。
tasks.objective_text_en: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 勇士的召唤！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往祖达克的痛苦斗兽场，寻找古尔戈索克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out Gurgthock at the Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 回首往事
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王要求你前往落雷谷，收集8块号角碎片。
tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 8 Horn Fragments from Thunderfall.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 亡者的纪念碑
tasks.objective_text_zh: 约库姆国王要求你将号角碎片交给丹尼芬雷的亚米尔德。
tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum wants you to bring Hodir's Horn Fragments to Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 霍迪尔的呼唤
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往落雷谷，击败5名尼芬雷先祖和5名永不疲倦的霜脉矮人，并对他们的尸体吹响霍迪尔的号角。然后将霍迪尔的号角带回丹尼芬雷。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to defeat 5 Niffelem Forefathers and 5 Restless Frostborn at Thunderfall. You are then to blow Hodir's Horn over their corpses, then return to Hodir's Horn in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进攻尼达维里尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁要你前往尼达维里尔，杀死10个雷铸铁矮人的士兵。雷铸勇士、雷铸大法师或雷铸作战魔像都可以。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to kill 10 Nidavelir Stormforged. You may kill Stormforged Champions, Stormforged Magi, or Stormforged War Golems.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 黑暗的护甲板
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将4份黑暗护甲板样品交给布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 4 Dark Armor Samples to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 护甲板的秘密
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把黑暗护甲板带到米米尔的车间去，让随从托克检查它。完成任务后，向布德克拉格庇护所的布鲁沃·斩铁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Dark Armor Plate to Mimir's Workshop and ask Attendant Tock to examine it. When you're finished, return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 热与冷
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往霜原湖，消灭脆弱的亡魂，并对冒烟的碎片使用冰之精华。收集6块冻铁碎片，将它们带回丹尼芬雷的弗约恩之砧。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to go to Frostfield Lake, kill the Brittle Revenants there and use the Essence of Ice on the Smoldering Scraps at Fjorn's Anvil. You are then to collect 6 of the Frozen Iron scraps and return to Fjorn's Anvil in Dun Niffelem.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 黑锋囚犯
tasks.objective_text_zh: 暗影拱顶的被折磨的维林要求你去解救8位黑锋囚犯。你可以在尤顿海姆地区的各个牢笼里找到他们。
tasks.objective_text_en: Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault wants you to free 8 Ebon Blade Prisoners. They can be found in the cages throughout the greater Jotunheim region.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 最后的母熊
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你去冬眠洞穴解救一头冰喉母熊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to rescue an Icemaw Matriarch in the Hibernal Cavern.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风暴之子瓦杜兰
tasks.objective_text_zh: 当你发现风暴之子瓦杜兰时，使用布德克拉格的作战号角。击败风暴之子瓦杜兰，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use Bouldercrag's War Horn when you have found Valduran the Stormborn. Defeat Valduran the Stormborn and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 雷铸徽记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的亚米尔德要求你前往霜原湖，对那一带的死亡的铁巨人使用钻石尖锄，收集8枚雷铸徽记，然后回去向他复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld in Dun Niffelem needs you to use the Diamond Tipped Pick on the Dead Iron Giants at Frostfield Lake and return to him when you have collected 8 Stormforged Eyes.

extra_objectives.text: Use Diamond Tipped Pick on the corpses of Dead Iron Giants

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 泰坦的命运
tasks.objective_text_zh: 山底平原的克莱特乌斯要求你前往创世神殿、寒冬神殿、生命神殿和秩序神殿，并使用数据库探查这些区域。
tasks.objective_text_en: Creteus in the Foot Steppes has requested that you travel to the Temple of Invention, the Temple of Winter, the Temple of Life, and the Temple of Order and utilize the databank to examine each area.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 放置霍迪尔之盔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 亚米尔德要求你飞到丹尼芬雷北边的冰柱顶端，并在那里使用宣告石板。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld wants you to fly to the tip of the northern ice spike in Dun Niffelem and use the Tablets of Pronouncement.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 摧毁熔炉！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用布德克拉格的炸弹摧毁北部闪电熔炉、中部闪电熔炉和南部闪电熔炉，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy the North Lightning Forge, the Central Lightning Forge, and the South Lightning Forge with Bouldercrag's Bombs, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 黑暗的冰虫
tasks.objective_text_zh: 艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你到布伦希尔达村东边的冬眠洞穴去，杀死8条饥饿的冰虫。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar wants you to slay 8 Ravenous Jormungar in the Hibernal Cavern east of Brunnhildar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 正中要害
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死10名雷铸技师，然后返回布德克拉格庇护所，向布鲁沃·斩铁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Stormforged Artificers and return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 干掉那些维库人！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 暗影拱顶的劣尸维尔希望你在尤顿海姆地区消灭15个维库人。
tasks.objective_text_en: Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to slay any 15 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 巨像的威胁
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到巨像攻击规格说明书和巨像防御规格说明书，并把它们交给布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve the Colossus Attack Specs and Colossus Defense Specs and bring them to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 猎杀间谍
tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败上古寒冬山谷中的3名雷铸间谍。 /  / 对座狼的尸体使用灵体座狼之牙，召唤出一只灵体冰霜座狼，帮助你找出隐藏的敌人。完成任务之后向丹尼芬雷的冰霜座狼母兽复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: You must defeat 3 Stormforged Spies in the Valley of Ancient Winters. /  / Using the Ethereal Worg's Fang at the Corpse of the Fallen Worg will summon an Ethereal Frostworg, which will expose hidden enemies. You are to return to the Frostworg Denmother in Dun Niffelem when the valley has been cleansed of spies.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 彰显军威
tasks.objective_text_zh: 暗影拱顶的斯利文男爵希望你前往尤顿海姆地区，将黑锋旗帜插在15具维库人的尸体附近。
tasks.objective_text_en: Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault wishes you to plant 15 Ebon Blade Banners near the corpses of vrykul found within the greater Jotunheim region.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 热身赛
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你使用冰喉母熊的缰绳打败基加拉格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch to defeat Kirgaraak.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 进入利齿之坑
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布伦希尔达村的艾丝崔·约利塔尔要你在利齿之坑里使用冰喉母熊的缰绳，并打败6头海德比武会战熊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Astrid Bjornrittar, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 风暴之心
tasks.objective_text_zh: 布德克拉格庇护所的塑石者布德克拉格希望你前往奥迪斯，尝试阻止纳维尔获取风暴之心。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to travel to Uldis and try to prevent Overseer Narvir from obtaining the Heart of the Storm.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 白骨女巫
tasks.objective_text_zh: 前往约尔达村附近的洞穴，与白骨女巫谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with The Bone Witch within the cave at Njorndar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 紧急措施
tasks.objective_text_zh: 血卫士洛尔加要你前往东边的基莫拉克之巢，收集6张座狼的毛皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bloodguard Lorga wants you to go to the Gimorak's Den to the east and obtain 6 Worg Furs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 打造霍迪尔之矛
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的博学者兰德维尔要求你前往冬眠洞穴收集3块永冻碎片，并从上古寒冬山谷的坚韧猛犸象身上收集3块坚韧猛犸象的毛皮。
tasks.objective_text_en: Lorekeeper Randvir in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 3 Everfrost Shards from the depths of Hibernal Cavern and 3 Stoic Mammoth Hides from the Stoic Mammoths in the Valley of Ancient Winters.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 屠龙记
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用霍迪尔之矛挑衅上古寒冬山谷的野生巨龙，然后与它决一死战。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to use Hodir's Spear to challenge a Wild Wyrm in the Valley of Ancient Winters. Once in its grip, you are to fight to the death.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 土灵的誓言
tasks.objective_text_zh: 造物者圣台的托里姆要求你使用峭壁号角召集土灵，并打败20个铁矮人和7个铁哨兵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim, at the Terrace of the Makers, wants you to use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat 20 Iron Dwarves and 7 Iron Sentinels.

extra_objectives.text: Use the Horn of the Peaks and call on the Earthen to defeat Iron Dwarves and Iron Sentinels

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 粘滞清洁
tasks.objective_text_zh: 进入丹尼芬雷以西的冬眠洞穴，从粘性油污身上收集5份粘性油。 /  / 然后返回丹尼芬雷，将油涂在霍迪尔的头盔上。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to enter Hibernal Cavern west of Dun Niffelem and collect 5 units of Viscous Oil from the Viscous Oils there. /  / You are then to return to Dun Niffelem and apply the oil to Hodir's Helm.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 钢铁巨像
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用被驯服的冰虫击败钢铁巨像，然后回到布德克拉格庇护所，向塑石者布德克拉格复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use a Tamed Jormungar to defeat the Iron Colossus and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

extra_objectives.text: Mount Tamed Jormungar to fight Iron Colossus

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 天灾的战术
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冰冠冰川银色前线基地的北伐军指挥官恩塔里要求你去解救8名被网住的北伐军士兵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you free 8 Webbed Crusaders.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 新的开始
tasks.objective_text_zh: 亚米尔德要求你将重铸的风暴之王铠甲交给风暴神殿的托里姆。
tasks.objective_text_en: Njormeld wants you to take the Reforged Armor to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 科洛米尔，风暴之锤
tasks.objective_text_zh: 托里姆要你与丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王谈一谈，向他打听科洛米尔的消息。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim wants you to talk to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem and discover what he knows of Krolmir.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 斩除尤卡塔尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王要求你前往冬眠洞穴，杀死尤卡塔尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to slay Jorcuttar in Hibernal Cavern.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 见证者与英雄
tasks.objective_text_zh: 唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔希望你去阅读第一份历史卷轴、第二份历史卷轴和第三份历史卷轴。
tasks.objective_text_en: Xarantaur, at Camp Tunka'lo, wants you to read the First History Scroll, the Second History Scroll, and the Third History Scroll.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 洛肯的副官
tasks.objective_text_zh: 托里姆要你杀死塑造者之厅的伊森法斯、造物者圣台的风之哈勒弗尼尔和符文巨人杜洛恩。
tasks.objective_text_en: Thorim wants you to slay Eisenfaust inside the Hall of the Shaper and Halefnir the Windborn and Duronn the Runeforged in the Terrace of the Makers.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 无上的荣耀
tasks.objective_text_zh: 向冰冠冰川银色前线基地的北伐军指挥官恩塔里报到。
tasks.objective_text_en: Report to Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 雷蹄的记忆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与浮冰深渊的迅矛酋长谈一谈，然后返回唐卡洛营地，向夏拉托尔复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Chieftain Swiftspear in Frostfloe Deep, then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 时间的扰动
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用酋长的图腾封闭4道浮冰裂隙，然后将图腾还给唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 保卫前线基地
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冰冠冰川银色前线基地的北伐军领主达尔弗斯要求你杀死15只遗忘深渊蛛魔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Crusader Lord Dalfors at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you kill 15 Forgotten Depths Nerubians.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 致命的剧毒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 冰冠冰川银色前线基地的古斯塔夫神父要求你交给他10个遗忘深渊毒囊。
tasks.objective_text_en: Father Gustav at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you bring him 10 Forgotten Depths Venom Sacs.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 地下大厅的深处
tasks.english_name: Deep in the Bowels of The Underhalls
tasks.objective_text_zh: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你调查学徒奥斯特基格，弄清楚恐怖博士的计划。 /  / 事成之后，击败学徒奥斯特基格，并回来向女巫汇报。
tasks.objective_text_en: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has asked you to beat information out of Apprentice Osterkilgr concerning what Dr. Terrible is truly up to. /  / You are then to slay the apprentice.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 一加一大于二
tasks.english_name: The Sum is Greater than the Parts
tasks.objective_text_zh: 登上尼尔盖德并控制它。抵御来自恐惧大厅的居民的攻击，直到恐怖博士现身。 /  / 操纵尼尔盖德杀死恐怖博士，然后返回约尔达村，向白骨女巫复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Mount and take control of Nergeld. Defend it from the denizens of the Hall of Horrors until Dr. Terrible shows himself. /  / Use Nergeld to slay the doctor, and then return to The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 如果还有幸存者……
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与冰冠冰川银色前线基地的本诺比奥斯谈一谈。

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.objective_text_zh: 让安格里姆吞食5条灵体冰虫，然后返回丹尼芬雷，向安格里姆的冰冻躯体复命。 /  / 你必须前往上古寒冬山谷，对游荡的冰虫使用安格里姆之牙。一旦它们脱离肉体，就与灵体形态的冰虫进行战斗，直到它们变得虚弱。
tasks.objective_text_en: You are to feed Arngrim 5 Disembodied Jormungar, then return to Arngrim's frozen image in Dun Niffelem. /  / You must go to the Valley of Ancient Winters and use Arngrim's Tooth on the Roaming Jormungar there. Once they have become disembodied, you must fight them until they are weakened.

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80

tasks.name: 英雄的装备

max_level_bonus_money.rate: 6 copper per base XP at level 80
